subject: Org bootstrap: admin roster & ephemeral API strategy
messages:
From: Emma Lang <emma.lang@clearstride.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@clearstride.ai>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff and first-step questions

Thanks Rachel — excited to get started. Two quick items from our side before the kickoff: 

1) How do you recommend we name the initial projects and API keys so our infra scripts can pick them up?
2) We need one short-lived (ephemeral) key for initial testing and a long-lived admin key for the service account. Any recommended TTLs/rotation cadence?

Attaching the first-pass list of ClearStride users and roles (clearstride_onboarding_manifest.xlsx). Happy to discuss on the kickoff but wanted to record these early.

—Emma
Emma Lang
Head of ML Ops, ClearStride
emma.lang@clearstride.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172
(Attachment: clearstride_onboarding_manifest.xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Lang <emma.lang@clearstride.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff and first-step questions

Thanks Emma — great questions. Short answers up front, details below: 

- Project + key naming: use org shorthand + environment + purpose (e.g., clearstride-prod-gen, clearstride-staging-admin).
- Ephemeral keys: 1–6 hour TTL for demos; 24 hours max for sandbox testing. Production admin keys: rotate every 30–90 days and bind to service accounts with least privilege.

Detailed plan and checklist below so Monica and Ben can action during the implementation sprint.

--Rachel
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment referenced: SOW-v1.2.pdf)

>

Hi team — I'm listing the concrete tasks I'll own in the first 48 hours and what I need from ClearStride to finish them: 

Action items (Monica, owner):
- Create org project scaffold in our console: clearstride-prod-gen, clearstride-prod-emb, clearstride-staging-admin (ETA: 3/2 EOD).
- Seed a service account for the production admin key and request ClearStride to confirm two admin users for SSA binding.
- Generate one ephemeral demo key (TTL 6h) and share via secure snippet for the engineering kick-off.

What I need from ClearStride:
- Confirm the two admin emails in the attached manifest (column: proposed_admin) by EOD 3/2.
- Confirm preferred naming prefix (default: clearstride).

I will upload the provisioning playbook to the shared Drive link and attach the SOW to the kickoff invite.

—Monica

Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Next steps (Ben, owner):

- Provision production projects and seed initial keys; notify ClearStride when they are ready for the infra onboarding session.
- Kickoff meeting scheduled: 2028-03-04 10:00 AM PT (invite to follow).

If anything changes on your side, reply-all. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan above.
